repos.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
repos.hook: This tool builds knowledge graphs from your data. A knowledge graph connects related pieces of information together. Large language models use these graphs to find accurate context. The framework helps your agents write exact database queries and explain their answers.
repos.personalization: Helpful if you need to ground prompt evaluations against structured Islamic jurisprudence or Islamic finance rule sets.

repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.hook: This tool saves memory for your AI coding agents across sessions. It records what an agent does while you work. Then, it condenses this history into small summaries. It injects these summaries into future sessions so your agent remembers previous decisions.
repos.personalization: Directly relevant if you want to benchmark how coding agents retain context across long fullstack development sessions.

repos.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
repos.hook: This command-line tool manages Git worktrees. A worktree lets you check out multiple branches at the same time in separate folders. The tool helps you run several AI coding agents on different tasks simultaneously without code conflicts.
repos.personalization: Useful for your AI tooling evaluations when you want to run parallel coding agents across Git branches without conflicts.

repos.hook: This repository contains reusable skills for AI agents. Anthropic designed these skills to give agents specific actions. Agents can run scripts, inspect files, and use external services through these definitions.
repos.personalization: Studying Anthropic's official skill definitions gives you practical prompt patterns to evaluate for your own tool-calling agents.

repos.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
repos.hook: This project organizes Claude Code into a simulated game development studio. It configures 49 separate AI agents with specific roles. The agents follow a structured hierarchy to design, write, and test games.
repos.personalization: Gives you a massive multi-agent prompt hierarchy to inspect if you want to evaluate how Claude Code handles complex agent roles.

repos.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
repos.hook: This project provides an open-source chatbot alternative to Grok. It includes a virtual machine. A virtual machine is an isolated software environment that acts like a separate computer. The bot runs code inside this safe sandbox to answer user questions.
This is an AI coding tool built by the T3 development team. It runs inside your terminal. It helps programmers generate and edit fullstack TypeScript code directly in their projects.
repos.personalization: Worth benchmarking against your current AI coding setup, especially since it focuses on fullstack TypeScript workflows.

repos.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
repos.hook: This tool provides design instructions for AI coding agents. It prevents models from generating generic, low-quality user interfaces. You add it to your agent to enforce clean CSS and modern typography.
repos.personalization: You can drop this into Claude Code or Cursor to prevent generic, sloppy UI output in your fullstack side projects.

repos.description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
repos.hook: This software library calculates traditional Chinese astrology charts. It implements calendar and alignment algorithms in TypeScript. It also includes an open knowledge base of historical reference texts.

repos.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
repos.hook: This Python library extracts data from websites. It can download a single web page or crawl entire sites. The tool automatically bypasses bot detection systems and parses complex HTML.
repos.personalization: Useful for building scrapers to collect financial disclosure data from Malaysian banking or Shariah-compliant market portals.

repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.hook: This command-line program lets AI agents control a web browser. An agent uses it to click buttons, fill forms, and take screenshots. The tool runs fast because developers wrote it in Rust.
repos.personalization: A handy CLI to evaluate if you want to automate end-to-end testing for your web apps using local agents.

repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.hook: This repository contains pre-made skills for AI developer agents. The author uses these skills for daily programming tasks. They teach your agent how to inspect TypeScript types, run tests, and refactor code cleanly.
repos.personalization: Great prompt examples to review if you want to optimize how AI agents handle TypeScript and fullstack refactoring.

repos.description: A collection of agent skills that help you build great interfaces.
repos.hook: This collection provides prompt instructions that guide AI agents during frontend development. The instructions contain clear rules for layout, colors, and user experience. You supply these rules to your agent to get consistent web component designs.
repos.personalization: Worth testing in your frontend workflow to see if structured UI prompts improve the quality of generated components.

repos.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with SDD or any other process!
repos.hook: This toolkit helps developers practice specification-driven development. In this workflow, you write clear technical requirements before you write code. The tool uses these written specifications to prompt AI agents to generate matching software.
repos.personalization: Fits directly into prompt optimization work, since clear technical specs make it easier to evaluate agent output accuracy.

repos.description: 🚀 PR Agent: The Original Open-Source PR Reviewer. This project is not the Qodo free tier.
repos.hook: This tool connects AI models to your Git repositories. It automatically reviews pull requests when developers submit code changes. It leaves line-by-line feedback, checks for security bugs, and generates change summaries.
repos.personalization: A solid real-world project to study if you want to evaluate automated prompt chains for code review.

repos.description: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks.
repos.hook: Hyprland is a window manager for Linux systems. A window manager controls the placement and appearance of application windows on your screen. Hyprland tiles your windows automatically and displays smooth visual animations.

repos.description: Agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text
repos.hook: This tool rewrites text to remove robotic phrases and predictable patterns. It detects common signs of AI-generated writing. Then, it adjusts the sentence rhythm and vocabulary so the text sounds natural.
repos.personalization: An interesting skill to evaluate if you want to optimize agent prompts to write more natural copy for your apps.
